macros.name: added
macros.doc: Some Bible translations mark out words added for clarity not found in the original language (e.g., in italics). This can be done using the \added function.

macros.name: canonicalheading
macros.doc: The \canonicalheading function inserts a canonical heading used at the beginning of many psalms.

macros.name: extraskip
macros.doc: Add a small vertical space of extraskip between a paragraph. This function attempts to add additional space to avoid a clash with a drop chapter if required.

macros.name: GOD
macros.doc: The \LORD and \GOD macros equivalent to \name{Lord} and \name{God} respectively.

macros.name: heading
macros.doc: The \heading function provides a simple section heading command for use within the scripture environment.

macros.name: LORD
macros.doc: The \LORD and \GOD macros equivalent to \name{Lord} and \name{God} respectively.

macros.name: nohang
macros.doc: In a hanging environment, this function indents the first line of the paragraph a length of hanging/hang + parindent. Remaining lines continue to be indented by a length of hanging/hang.

macros.name: nopilcrow
macros.doc: When pilcrow is true, this causes the next pilcrow that would normally by printed to be suppressed.

macros.name: redletteroff
macros.doc: Use \redletteron and \redletteroff to mark the beginning and end of sections of text that should be attributed to Jesus speaking.

macros.name: redletteron
macros.doc: Use \redletteron and \redletteroff to mark the beginning and end of sections of text that should be attributed to Jesus speaking.

macros.name: selah
macros.doc: In a poetry environment, this function inserts Selah at the end of the current line or the end of the following line if there is insufficient room.

envs.name: center
envs.doc: Environment for typesetting centred sections of scripture quotations.

envs.name: flushright
envs.doc: Environment for typesetting right aligned sections of scripture quotations.

envs.name: narrow
envs.doc: Environment for typesetting narrow sections of scripture quotations.
